subject.title: feat: custodian chat result carries the real wizard step

question: May `SystemAgentChatResult.step` carry `initialValue` for wizard steps marked `sensitive`, including values that may be credentials or tokens?
rationale: The intended expand-contract design conflicts with the existing purpose of `sensitive`; choosing redaction versus an explicitly protected client contract is a product and security-boundary decision, not a mechanical test repair.

options.title: Redact sensitive initial values
options.body: Transmit the full step shape but omit `initialValue` when `sensitive` is true, then add focused protocol and engine coverage.

options.title: Approve protected end-to-end transport
options.body: Keep the value only after owners document which clients, histories, logs, and reconnect flows may receive it and add proof for that contract.

recommendation.title: Redact sensitive initial values
recommendation.body: Transmit the full step shape but omit `initialValue` when `sensitive` is true, then add focused protocol and engine coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR author owns the concrete protocol proposal and can route the required security-boundary decision to the appropriate feature owners.
